text: I stand at the threshold between knowledge and creation. On one side, a gathering of minds focuses behind glass—a space of structured learning. On the other, vibrant colors and bold letters proclaim 'R+D,' a celebration of invention and possibility. Here, I feel both the calm gravity of inquiry and the restless urge to innovate. It is invigorating to witness the interplay between contemplation and creation, as if each asks me to choose a path, or perhaps to unite both within myself.
